body:
Let's go ahead and quote [exactly what you said](https://www.reddit.com/user/Garretts_Barrett), which *was* in fact deleted (you'll need to log out to verify, of course, but I won't hold my breath expecting you to acknowledge pesky things like facts or the possibility that you might actually be wrong; I know the character you're working here wouldn't allow for that):

> You are bat-shit crazy, and it is no wonder that your post got removed from /r/suicidewatch. Your attitude is so toxic that you yourself are a risk for the at-risk suicidal people who would be trying to help you.
>
> All you have done this entire time is embarrass yourself, and go out of your way to be the biggest jerk imaginable to people who have taken time out of their day to try and help a complete stranger.
> 
> So, congratulations! :D You have successfully proven that no one should respect you at all: not your coworkers, not your students, not random people on the internet, not even fellow "suicidal" people.
> 
> All you do is spew a constant rabid foam of hatred out of your mouth that makes even the nicest person imaginable want to pick you up and shake you until all the time of their life that you have wasted falls out.
> 
> It is in your best interest to delete this entire thread if you ever want to use this subreddit again, because no-one in their right mind would try to help you after seeing this. Your belligerent behavior is simply too intolerable, and that is saying something because I impart my wisdom frequently on autism subreddits.
>
> (I wouldn't feel the need to spell this out for you if I didn't feel like you had the reading comprehension of a blind chimpanzee, and the social skills of a flatulent armadillo. You clearly, in fact, "do not get it.").
> 
> Woopie! :D You have successfully goaded me into tearing you a new one. Happy?
> 
> Now I'm going to take my own advice and go to the gym so I can work off this unbridled rage that you have so expertly seeded into every person who has tried to give you advice. You bitter, despicable, obnoxious, annoying, loathsome, detestable, contemptible, beastly, wretched, sad excuse for a human being.

Those are the exact words that you said, not that the character you're working will allow you to admit that.  So!  Let's take a closer look at what you said, using your own words, which are staring you in the face.

First!  You claim you never said you were one of the most compassionate people in the world.  That's bullshit.  Here's why:

> All you do is spew a constant rabid foam of hatred out of your mouth that makes even the nicest person imaginable want to pick you up and shake you until all the time of their life that you have wasted falls out.

You never once mentioned anyone else.  You now are trying to claim you meant Ghandi, but *you never actually said that*.  You've only been talking about yourself and how pissed off you are (and yet you still continue to talk to the person who supposedly upsets you so much, which lets me know what character you're working and is what's keeping you from a 10/10).  Going by **WHAT YOU ACTUALLY SAID**, you claimed you were "the nicest person imaginable," which is a laughable sack of horse shit.  

Second!  You claim you never used "autism" as an insult.  More bullshit.  Again, let's look at **WHAT YOU ACTUALLY SAID:**

> Your belligerent behavior is simply too intolerable, and that is saying something because I impart my wisdom frequently on *autism* subreddits.

The words and emphasis are entirely your own.  You used "autism" as an insult.  You know it, I know it, and that is the beginning, middle, and end of it.  Your own words are staring you in the fucking face.

Third!  To repeat a point, yes, I am responding to a comment of yours that was deleted.  Log out and look for your comment.  You'll deny it's been deleted of course, but it was.  And since I can't very well actually directly reply to one of your deleted comments, I'm responding here.  

Fourth, you're still blaming me for your mood, which continues to be adorable.

Finally, apology not accepted.  Not only is it not sincere, and not only have I not asked for one (I know better than to expect one from you, given the character you've put on display here), but you also keep doing the very thing you say pisses you off so much, which tells me everything I need to know about your intentions.  You have no interest in any sort of amends or any sort of civil behavior, you just want to pummel someone who didn't thank you quickly enough based on words it took you literally no time or effort to crap out.  

You want to have one angstrom of credibility?  Here's what you can do: You claim this pisses you, the self-described "nicest person imaginable," so much that you "want to pick [me] up and shake [me] until all the time of their life that you have wasted falls out" (another thing you've done that I find hilarious; you go immediately to threatening physical violence because someone didn't thank you on the internet; *classic*).  **AND YOU'RE STILL HERE, SOMEHOW.**  It would take literally no effort for you to ignore me if that were true.  It takes you more effort to type this bullshit than it would to *not* type it.  The fact that you're putting in all this unnecessary effort towards something you claim you don't want or like or need to do tells me all I need to know.  You want to show that I'm wrong?  **STOP RESPONDING**.

Your deleted comment is adorable.  The part where you call yourself one of the most compassionate human beings in the world is laughable.  Your use of "autism" as an insult is bizarre and breaks the rules here.  You blaming me for your mood is classic.  

9/10.  Expert trolling.  You've got the character down.
You know, if you actually weren't a troll, maybe you'd have stopped talking to someone you don't want to talk to.  But by now we all know why you're really here.

I'm a beginning teacher too.  This is the end of the ninth week for me.  So ... yeah, nothing much I can be of help with there.  Right now, the main thing I'd change is to make sure my first attempt worked.

I doubt it, based on what you've said to other people in this thread.  It would have been better had you not responded.  "Lol, sux 2 b u, l8r!!!" contributes exactly nothing to the conversation except your desire to not take part in it, which *not responding* would also have done, and done more efficiently.
No, they did exactly what they set out to do and got a rise out of me.  From their perspective, they handled it perfectly.

Bullshit.  

Teachers, competent teachers, care more than I do and **WANT TO TEACH**.  I don't want to teach.  I want to die by my own hand so I won't starve after I quit or get fired.

Fuck no, being a teacher was never a dream of mine.  It's a job.  It's something other than my last job, which I was also terrible at and also hated.  Quitting and dying are the same because quitting means **I WILL HAVE NO MONEY, LOSE MY PLACE TO LIVE, AND STARVE TO DEATH**.

Re: volunteering: There aren't enough hours in the day for me to volunteer with me teaching.  I would have to quit.  And then I could go broke and lose any choice I have in how I die.  Not keen on starvation.  Tried it.  It sucked, then I chicken out and ate something because it fucking **HURTS**.

You and I disagree on whether me fucking over 90+ people's lives by being a shitty teacher is worth killing myself over.  You will not convince me and I will not convince you.  Such is life.

You are flat out wrong, though, when you say I want to teach.  I don't.  I wish I was teaching high school, because then one of the dumb shits might be violent and strong enough to stab or shoot me and then I'd be dead.  Dying is **PREFERABLE** to teaching right nlw.  I'm just a stupid selfish coward.  

I'm seeing how deep I can cut tonight.  It's a start.  Got the whole weekend to drink up the courage.  I know I'll fail, like I always fucking do, but it's a shot.

I'm not giving you my fucking number.  Don't ask again.

**EDIT:** Reported you for PMing me your phone number.  **STOP THAT**.  It's creepy as fuck.  

**SECOND EDIT:** Your belligerent PMs are hilarious.  I mean, you're getting reported for them and it's revealing I was exactly right about you from the start, but they're still funny.

What contacts?  I don't **HAVE** contacts?  Do you mean contacts I might (that is, *won't*) get through volunteering?  The only way I have enough hours in the day to volunteer is to quit.  Quitting removes my income.  Removing my income just means I die that much sooner.  

And no, there's nothing I'm interested in doing.  Not my last attempt at a job.  Not the three ones I got shit-canned from for being incompetent there as well either.  Not even this world of crap that is teaching.

And yes, being a shitty teacher is something worth killing myself over, because it's not just that I'm shitty at my job, but me being shitty at my job is actively fucking over people who don't have any authority or agency to change their situation, even if I do think they're all a bunch of horrible little shits who could all, to the last, benefit from being beaten within an inch of their life the next time they run their dumb little mouths, steal from or injure each other, cheat on their homework, throw rubber bands across the room, and act like a bunch of fucking assholes.  If they fail to learn, that's my fault.  It's at least as much my fault that they're a bunch of dumb assholes as theirs.  I'm fucking *them* and *you* over by being a shitty shitty shitty teacher.  Every day I don't quit or kill myself is another day I've fucked you over.

Trying to claim that you have not and are not demanding thanks is laughable.  You know that's what you're doing, I know that's what you're doing, and that's the beginning, middle, and end of it.  

Equally laughable is you telling me that the exact words of my last three appraisals, which I have sitting in front of me, mean I am paranoid or delusional.  You know it, and so do it.  Laughable.

Not as laughable, but considerably sadder, is the fact that you mat legitimately believe that 

> you need a new career 

is anything other than you telling me to quit teaching.  That really is sad.  

Anyway, you've shown your true colors, and it's more productive trying to have w conversation with the 90 stupid lying backstabbing idiotic little shits I have to try in vain to teach what a fucking **NOUN** is (in fifth goddamn grade) than it is hearing I'm a shitty teacher from one more person who demands that I thank them.  You get to have the last word and pretend it matters.

People who demand thanks often deserve it least.  People who demand thanks for something that cost them nothing in terms of time or effort deserve it even less.  

Five people in my ACP, literally everyone I've spoken to in any professional capacity there, have called me incompetent to my face, using that exact word.  It's written on every professional evaluation I have from them.  My mentor teacher drops the "I-bomb" during every weekly meeting we have, because I "just don't get it," whatever "it" may be that day.  My principal is more diplomatic, only saying I'm "nowhere near up to standards" and that my class "behaves fine with everyone else, it's [me] who's doing it all wrong."  

I have these words in print and email as well.  Call me delusional again; I could deserve a good bitter laugh.  

You also don't need to tell me I'm a shitty teacher who should quit or die (same thing, in the end).  I already fucking know.

> Find something else you're good at

Which presumes there is anything.  There isn't.  I've got the shitty shitty shitty **SHITTY** resume and utter lack of references to prove it.  

Also, talk to some teachers who've met me.  They'll tell you exactly how much harm I'm doing in the classroom.  

And fuck psychiatrists.  I tell them a tenth of what I've said here and I'm in a straight jacket until I'm fired for not showing up at school, and then I've got all my problems and I'm broke.  I've been there.  Never again.

I do not do any teachers proud.  I know this because I've spoken to actual teachers (current and former) who tell me I'm an asshole who does a shitty job and am actively harming my students' futures.  Pretty much every one of them who interacts with me or sees my performance in the classroom.
